_doc: R0 B.1 weapons.json: WeaponDef[] (owner 02). Values from 02 s4.1 table (anchors and 01-fixed values). Fields shown as '-' in 02 are omitted (default 0 / null). range_min_m 300 for siege_gun (R0 B.8 A-2). weapon_mount ground for siege_gun (R0 B.8 A-3; owner ruling 2026-10-13: Foundry x0.85 stays ship-only). Weapon ids are a per-file namespace; the weapon 'bomb' and the projectile 'bomb' are both kept (R0 B.8 A-1). Weapons have no 07 asset prefix, so presentation is empty (07 s10).
